summary: Corrected neuroendocrine (NE) markers: CHGA, SYP, GRP, GHRL, TTR, ASCL1, NEUROD1, NEUROG3, RFX6, PROX1 and negative RFX6 for classical pulmonary NE are formal and in scope. No formal Schwann/PNS markers could be extracted because PNS cells are only mentioned as scarce and not further analyzed. All non-target lung epithelial/mesenchymal/endothelial candidates are excluded from the target marker table.

issues.description: Several neuroendocrine markers (GRP, GHRL, TTR, RFX6, NEUROD1, NEUROG3, PROX1) were previously downgraded to context_only despite author_declared/annotation/figure_labeled evidence; corrected to include.

Many candidates from non-target cell types (lung epithelium, secretory cells, ciliated cells, basal cells, endothelial, mesenchymal, contaminants) were retained in the candidate list; all are excluded as outside target_cell_scope.

PNS/Schwann target scope: no formal marker genes could be extracted. Paper only states PNS cells were clustered and assigned to cell types but scarcity precluded further analysis; no gene-cell marker evidence is readable.
Non-unique/family symbols (SFTPA, DNAH, SCGB3A) were marked ambiguous. PVLAP->PLVAP, NDUF4AL2->NDUFA4L2, NASPA->NAPSA, E-cadherin->CDH1, DeltaNTP63->TP63 were resolved as alias/isoform.
All included markers are from human fetal lung samples (species=human). Mouse Ghrl+ NE absence is noted in text but not used as human marker evidence.
